ingredientSections.heading: Breakfast Dogs
items: 2 Tbsp Tahitian Vanilla Curd Cream (available at The End of the Line)
16 Mini breakfast sausages (or any savoury but not spicy sausages)

methodSections.heading: Breakfast Dogs
steps: In a bowl large enough to easily hold the hotdog buns, mix the eggs and milk together well. Dip the pre-cut buns in the egg mix covering them thoroughly. Pan fry the buns until golden on both the top and bottom.
Bake or pan fry the sausages.
Whip the cream to medium peaks, add the vanilla curd and whip some more until it is fairly firm.
Place the sausages on the buns with the fruit, then drop a few good dollops of cream on top and finally drizzle with maple syrup.
